company.name: Graphify Labs
company.shortDescription: On-device knowledge graph engine for enterprises.
company.description:
Graphify Labs builds an on-device knowledge graph engine for enterprises. It creates queryable knowledge graphs from local codebases, docs, and Jira, giving engineering teams and their coding agents one shared, always-current view of the codebase.

On that graph, Graphify's enterprise layer reviews every pull request and formally verifies each code change, proving the new behavior matches the old or handing back the exact input that breaks it. The graph updates itself as the code changes, keeping context instead of forgetting it.

Graphify runs fully on-premise, so no data leaves the building. The open-source engine has reached 105K+ GitHub stars and roughly 5M+ downloads, and is used in production by engineering teams at Rootly, Geotab, Tweddle Group, and Superagent.

Graphify Labs is a Y Combinator company (S26).
